description.value: Gold Pan Motel is a budget-friendly 20-room motel on Front Street in Quesnel, a town at the heart of BC's historic Gold Rush country along the Fraser River. The property is open 24 hours, is pet-friendly, and sits within walking distance of several riverside parks including Fraser River Park and LeBourdais Park. It offers free parking and free WiFi, making it a straightforward overnight stop for travellers moving through the Cariboo region.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and corroborates OSM data throughout. Phone number (250) 992-2107 and address 855 Front St, Quesnel, BC V2J 2L3 are confirmed on every page. Free WiFi is explicitly listed as an amenity on the front page and About page; Begbie's Bar & Bistro is cited at 700 metres on the front page, confirming nearby evening food. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, e-bike charging, or most other cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM email field contains a malformed value ('reserve@goldpanmotel.ca + 1 250 992 2107' — phone number appended to email address). The website contact page lists a different address: info@goldpanmotel.ca.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating motel with an active website, confirmed address, and visible amenities — a straightforward overnight option for cyclists passing through Quesnel.

Nearby evening food.detail: Begbie's Bar & Bistro listed at 700 metres from the motel on the front page
